applies_to: Carrier AquaEdge 23XRV variable-speed water-cooled screw chillers with the PIC6 touchscreen controller.
summary: The PIC6 controller on the 23XRV talks BACnet MS/TP (port J8) or BACnet IP (Ethernet) natively, plus Modbus, with no translator. The object list is a flat set of AV, BV and MSV objects named <CCN table>_<point>, covering unit status, temperatures and pressures per circuit, capacity, VFD data, setpoints and service settings. Network start must be enabled on the controller before BMS commands are obeyed.
notes: The table has no units column; values follow the controller's configured unit system.
Many configuration and factory objects are listed as RW; treat FACTORY_ and SERVICE1_ objects as commissioning-only.
Integration with a BAS is not part of the standard Carrier start-up and is done by a Carrier controls technician.

source.title: AquaEdge 23XRV Variable Speed High-Efficiency Screw Liquid Chillers - Controls Operation and Troubleshooting

integration.summary: Enable BACnet MS/TP or BACnet IP under System Configuration > BMS protocol, then enable Network start on the Configure Startup Options screen. In Network mode the chiller runs when both its start/stop and occupancy inputs are true; monitor unit status, leaving/entering water and alarms, and write the LCW setpoint.

minimum_points.name: PROTOCOL_BAC_S_S
minimum_points.why: BACnet start/stop command as seen by the chiller

integration.enable: Network start for BACnet must be ticked on the Configure Startup Options screen (User login or higher). In Network mode the chiller starts only when CHIL_S_S and CHIL_OCC are both true; each enabled start source must send a stop to stop the chiller. BACnet emergency stop (PROTOCOL_BACESTOP) is one of the emergency-stop sources.
setup: Port J8 is RS-485 for BACnet MS/TP or Modbus RTU; BACnet MS/TP and BACnet IP cannot both be enabled.
Modbus RTU can run alongside BACnet IP, and BACnet MS/TP alongside Modbus TCP.
Ethernet ports: J15 defaults to 169.254.1.1/16, J16 to 192.168.100.100/24; DHCP is not supported.
For BACnet IP set the IP config and any BBMD, then select Reboot; for MS/TP set MAC, baud and keep Max Masters low.
gotchas: The points table marks the PROTOCOL_BAC* command objects read-only; confirm which objects accept writes on the live controller before mapping commands.
Object names carry the CCN table prefix (e.g. TEMP_, SETPOINT_, GENUNIT_); several descriptions in the table are internal variable names.

note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source). Point availability varies by firmware and options; verify against the live device.
